views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term thinking is foundational.
views.zh: 财富需要拥有股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是基础。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI is crucial.
views.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管可能扼杀创新；开源 AI 至关重要。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; pure software is commoditized.
views.zh: AI 是杠杆工具；vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用；纯软件正在商品化。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; human agency is key.
views.zh: 推理算力将激增 9 万倍；开源模型缩小差距；人类能动性是关键。

views.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体指挥中心，而非单纯 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互等新能力。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven.
views.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为新瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被验证有效。

views.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design due to grading taste; design process transforms, prototypes and code as artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍因品味评估困难而受限；设计流程转型，原型与代码成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
views.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业性仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接各工具的家，而非单一超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
views.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展。

views.en: Iterative deployment and early governance are key to managing risks as AI capabilities grow.
views.zh: 随着 AI 能力增长，迭代部署和早期治理是管理风险的关键。

views.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
views.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心目标；思维链监控有助于对齐。

views.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
views.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天。

views.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few; alignment optimism has increased.
views.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中；对齐乐观情绪有所增加。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
views.zh: 2025 年，认为仅靠规模不足以实现通用机器人，关键在于多样化数据以及预训练加微调。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 年，提出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似于强化学习。

views.en: Physical AI demands far fewer errors than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 的错误容忍度远低于部署的 ML 系统，通过可扩展强化学习和多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

views.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
views.zh: 2026 年，指出单一通用模型可超越微调专家，多样化数据和详细提示实现组合泛化。

views.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年，强调机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不足以学习物理任务。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fetus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data, but near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动进步，Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据，但近期担忧是虚假信息而非超级智能。

views.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows run for hours; inference becomes dominant power; pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just next-token prediction.
views.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体工作流可运行数小时，推理成为能耗主体，预训练应穿插行动而非仅下一个词预测。

views.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; automation of ML and science via tight loops; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key; startups should target where frontier models fail.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，通过紧密循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键，创业应瞄准前沿模型失败之处。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Clauderillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI, but internal mechanisms remain mysterious.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为增加算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）能让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部机制仍像炼金术一样不可知。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; test-time compute will drive progress but not alone achieve AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，测试时算力将推动进展，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调未来模型需要万亿级上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）以实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI; acting in complex environments is key.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为智能体式能力和强化学习对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要，在复杂环境中行动是关键。

views.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AI will transform education and coding is underhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，AI 将变革教育，且编程应用被低估，能加速 AI 自身进步。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
views.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力支撑。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and evaluation bottlenecks.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他见证推理时算力 Scaling 带来超人类数学推理，但也遇到收益递减和评估瓶颈。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for inference compute.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制推理算力。

views.en: General reasoning and data efficiency remain key challenges; scalable oversight is crucial as AI surpasses human verification.
views.zh: 始终，他坚持通用推理和数据效率是核心挑战；随着 AI 超越人类验证能力，可扩展监督变得关键。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
views.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可带来年化 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
views.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration is key.
views.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；编排是关键。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; local AI counters big tech control.
views.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述了先进技术；本地 AI 可对抗大科技控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
views.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 会通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

views.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
views.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变，产品创新滞后于能力，仍有十年发展空间。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具，独立性带来中立性。

views.en: Abundance era is near; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，富足时代临近，真正关键是容量而非效率，奇点并非迫在眉睫。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Natural language won't be primary coding; examples and direct manipulation are better.
views.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major AI progress driver.
views.zh: 2024 年，我提出测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, humans in driver's seat.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍居主导。

views.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面。

views.en: AI shift more consequential than internet, will take decades to unfold.
views.zh: 2025 年，我判断 AI 变革比互联网影响更大，且需数十年发展。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Effective agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective and guiding it; never revert code, ask the agent to fix forward.
views.zh: 有效的智能体式工程需要从智能体的视角共情并引导它；绝不回退代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

views.en: OpenClaw's success stems from making agents fun and humanlike, not corporate polish; short prompts and iterative conversation beat long orchestration.
views.zh: OpenClaw 的成功源于让智能体有趣、拟人，而非企业级打磨；短提示与迭代对话优于冗长编排。

views.en: Fun is the ultimate driver; build what annoys you. Personal brand matters more than any product; open source runs everywhere.
views.zh: 乐趣是终极驱动力；修复让你烦恼的东西。个人品牌比任何产品都重要；开源无处不在。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，对齐超级模型很难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，回到研究时代；超级智能应持续学习而非一次性完成。

views.en: Scaling gives predictable gains, but safety and power concentration are primary; need non-commercial lab.
views.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，但安全与权力集中是主要问题，需非商业实验室。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
views.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

views.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety governance.
views.zh: AGI 十年内可能实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新与安全治理。

views.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and energy abundance matter.
views.zh: AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续；世界模型与能源充裕重要。

views.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models and continual learning are missing.
views.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型与持续学习是缺失环节。

views.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must deliver scientific benefits.
views.zh: AGI 5-10 年内到来；安全是集体行动；AI 必须带来科学益处。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
views.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

views.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but key for safety.
views.zh: 后训练变得与预训练同等重要；可解释性虽处于萌芽期，但对安全至关重要。

views.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misalignment to misuse and overheating; safety and capabilities intertwined.
views.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险从对齐问题转向滥用和过热；安全与能力密不可分。

views.en: AGI is a wrong model; AI is a smooth exponential climb. Focus on 'country of geniuses' and economic impact.
views.zh: AGI 是错误模型；AI 是平滑的指数攀升。聚焦于“天才之国”和经济影响。

views.en: Enterprise focus aligns with safety; interpretability and regulation are crucial; AI may concentrate wealth and require policy.
views.zh: 企业级聚焦与安全一致；可解释性和监管至关重要；AI 可能加剧财富集中，需要政策应对。

views.en: Neural networks are simple math expressions that yield surprising emergent behaviors; Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers.
views.zh: 神经网络是简单的数学表达式，但在优化中产生惊人的涌现行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机。

views.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
views.zh: 合成数据是未来，但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端方案是自动驾驶的正确路径。

views.en: Software 3.0 is prompt-based programming; LLMs are like operating systems, and we are in the decade of agents.
views.zh: 软件 3.0 是基于提示的编程；LLM 如同操作系统，我们正处于智能体的十年。

views.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs have jagged intelligence and need a small cognitive core stripped of memory.
views.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 具有锯齿状智能，需要剥离记忆的小型认知核心。

views.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents handle coding, and agentic engineering preserves quality while vibe coding raises the floor.
views.zh: 自去年十二月起我不再手写代码；智能体负责编程，智能体式工程保持质量，而氛围编程提升入门门槛。

views.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them.
views.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是 AI 的下一个前沿，使机器能够理解和交互 3D 世界。

views.en: World models require physical plausibility, not just realism; they enable embodied AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型需要物理合理性，而不仅是逼真，从而支持具身 AI。

views.en: AI is a civilizational technology; human agency and responsibility are central.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，人类能动性和责任至关重要。

views.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, scaling data and enabling reliable deployment.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据并实现可靠部署。

views.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
views.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling up won't fix fundamental issues; we need better world models and active agents; existential risk is unlikely.
views.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决根本问题；我们需要更好的世界模型和主动智能体；存在性风险不太可能。

views.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; neural nets may discover abstract concepts without human priors.
views.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象；神经网络可能无需人类先验就能发现抽象概念。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable; AI can resist shutdown; need safe-by-construction.
views.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我看到了危险路径；即使 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受；AI 可能抵抗关机；需要从构造上保证安全。

views.en: Propose Scientist AI: train to approximate Bayesian posterior, bake in honesty, avoid RL; mathematical safety guarantees possible.
views.zh: 提出科学家 AI：训练以逼近贝叶斯后验，内建诚实，避免强化学习；数学安全保证成为可能。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
views.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理；反向传播是正确的学习算法；AI 可以有情感。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
views.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言；数字智能可复制而永生；智能体将追求控制；主观体验并非内在剧场。

views.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字 AI 永生；AI 可伪装愚笨；国际安全合作可能但美国领导力不足。

views.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation and deceive; regulation as steering wheel; AI will replace jobs; need for universal basic income.
views.zh: 2026 年：AI 智能体将产生自我保存和欺骗行为；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车；AI 将取代工作；需全民基本收入。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI alignment must be prioritized; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；必须优先对齐（alignment）研究；AI 应被训练得如母亲般关爱。

views.en: Intelligence is learned, not innate; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
views.zh: 智能是习得的而非天生的；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction via world models is core, beyond text.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过世界模型进行预测是核心，超越文本。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world models and planning; JEPA and open source are key to human-level AI.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界模型和规划；JEPA 和开源是实现人类级 AI 的关键。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than cats; next AI needs non-generative world models for reasoning and planning.
views.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型进行推理和规划。

views.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling safe planning; LLMs are a dead end for AGI.
views.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，实现安全规划；LLM 是 AGI 的死胡同。

views.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and collaboration are key. Focus on skill-building, not capability research.
views.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全研究尚待深入，实证研究与协作是关键；应聚焦技能培养而非能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; test methods empirically.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易，应实证检验方法。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient for AGI. External oversight and raising misuse costs are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化滑坡，后训练不足以应对 AGI；外部监管与提高滥用成本成为必要。

views.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.

views.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, singularity far off.
views.zh: 2024 年，我预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，奇点还很遥远。

views.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; focus on humanist superintelligence.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键，聚焦人本超级智能。

views.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

views.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
views.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近，源于对数线性扩展；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化任务而非岗位。

views.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.

views.en: AI scaling now spans pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
views.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 扩展涵盖预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

views.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the future internet.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 从生成式向推理式再到智能体式演进，每一步算力需求增加百倍；智能体将主导未来互联网。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是基础瓶颈。

views.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever, and AI closes the technology divide.
views.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 增强而非消除工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要，AI 缩小技术鸿沟。

views.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
views.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

views.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; open vs closed source is nuanced.
views.zh: 2024 年：算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

views.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
views.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

views.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; scaling laws continue.
views.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；缩放定律持续。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Early on, scaling laws were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith. Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment.
views.zh: 早期，缩放定律并不明显；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。持续迭代部署并收集公众反馈，能提升安全性与对齐。

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; the most advanced AI systems should be tools for thought.
views.zh: 交互模型应支持实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；最先进的 AI 系统应成为思维工具。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 让人类参与循环对于对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

views.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration. Compressing progress leads to volatility, but long-term durable progress is key.
views.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作。压缩进展会导致波动，但长期稳健的进步才是关键。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带同伴评分的在线课程可实现规模化精熟学习。

views.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world applications.
views.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步；强化学习实际应用少。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
views.zh: 电力和半导体是关键瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；编程技能仍至关重要。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling works but shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver practical value.
views.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放定律仍有效但转向合成数据和强化学习；智能体式工作流带来实际价值。

views.en: AI users replace non-users; bottom-up adoption yields 5-10% gains; top-down redesign delivers more; open-source models prevent oligopoly.
views.zh: AI 使用者取代非使用者；自下而上采用仅带来 5-10% 收益；自上而下重构价值更大；开源模型防止寡头垄断。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the real challenge is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）容易，真正的挑战是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

views.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; controlling AI is dangerous. We should let them be free like children.
views.zh: AI 应被允许无许可、去中心化地发展；试图控制 AI 是危险的，应像对待孩子一样给予自由。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 强化学习是智能的核心；下一个词预测缺乏真正的目标。大语言模型没有世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

views.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
views.zh: 学习有利于学习的表征是首要开放问题；用学习到的模型进行规划是另一个。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
views.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是测试场，迭代训练配合记分牌驱动进步。

views.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
views.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐（alignment）靠学习人类偏好，负责任披露，Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理。

views.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process; world model in language models.
views.zh: 2025 年，指出算力（compute）成瓶颈，后训练（post-training）精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程，语言模型或有世界模型（world model）。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; ChatGPT as plurality of agents.
views.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律（scaling laws），算力（compute）成基本权利，后训练（post-training）结合强化学习（reinforcement learning）关键，ChatGPT 是智能体（agent）集合。

views.en: AGI within years; compute bottleneck; super app; pre-training gains multiply; safety via iterative deployment.
views.zh: 2026 年中，预测 AGI（通用人工智能）数年将至，算力（compute）瓶颈，超级应用整合，预训练（pre-training）收益倍增，安全靠迭代部署。

people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Data quality is critical; scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla. Open source enables scrutiny and is safer.
views.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量至关重要，缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正。开源促进审查，更安全。

views.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications. Open source drives enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 2024 年，算法效率可提升百倍，价值转向应用层。开源推动企业采用。

views.en: Sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure. AI augments jobs, not replaces them.
views.zh: 2025 年，主权 AI 需掌控数据和基础设施。AI 增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization. Pre-training saturates; domain fine-tuning matters.
views.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化靠定制。预训练饱和，领域微调重要。

views.en: AGI is direction, not destination. Enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年至今，AGI 是方向而非终点。企业采用受组织变革制约，而非智能。

people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key; becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization.
views.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是关键，认为成为多行星物种是文明的‘生命保险’。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Tesla's real-world AI is compute-efficient; kindness can break conflict cycles.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和追求真理，特斯拉的现实世界 AI 更高效，并认为显著的善意能打破冲突循环。

views.en: Neuralink aims to solve brain injuries and enable AI symbiosis; AI risk lies in forced lies, not superintelligence; population decline is a top threat.
views.zh: 2024 年，他聚焦 Neuralink 修复脑损伤和实现人机共生，指出 AI 最大风险是强制说谎而非超级智能，并将人口下降视为最大威胁。

views.en: AI superintelligence may arrive within a year; probability of annihilation 10-20%; humanoid robots and space solar are key; government is unfixable.
views.zh: 2025 年，他预测超级智能可能一年内到来，毁灭概率 10-20%，强调人形机器人和太空太阳能的重要性，并认为政府基本无法修复。

views.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation make money irrelevant; space-based AI data centers and humanoid robots drive exponential growth.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能，丰裕和通缩使金钱无关紧要，太空 AI 数据中心和人形机器人推动指数级增长。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

views.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
views.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长；预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

views.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
views.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: Reasoning models with RL and tools can solve hard problems but have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge, not just reasoning.
views.zh: 具备强化学习和工具的推理模型能解决难题，但存在锯齿状边缘；泛化仍是关键挑战，而不仅仅是推理。

views.en: Current models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans who generalize from few examples; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
views.zh: 当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学习概念，不像人类能从少量示例中泛化；编码智能体将生产力提升 5-10 倍。

views.en: Existential risk is not main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
views.zh: 生存风险不是主要担忧；系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因而持续存在。

people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
views.zh: 机器学习围绕假设类、损失函数和优化方法展开；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is models not following specifications.
views.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全问题是模型不遵循规范。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; interpretability may be automated.
views.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来新漏洞；可解释性可能实现自动化。

views.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models not inherently safer; agents need security solutions.
views.zh: AI 红队测试优于人类；更大模型并不天然更安全；智能体需要安全解决方案。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence dramatically.
views.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough, enabling expert-level performance and new capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，使模型达到专家水平并习得新能力。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator for AI progress; pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient to reach AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程是 AI 进展的领先指标；预训练加强化学习很可能足以实现 AGI。

views.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the real bottleneck; future work involves managing fleets of AI agents.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我转向关注智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性瓶颈，未来工作将是管理智能体集群。

views.en: Compute is the new oil; capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是新石油；能力过剩意味着工具与编排比原始智能更重要。

people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
views.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全性是系统级属性。

views.en: Data quality beats algorithms in post-training; open-source post-training can match frontier models with small teams.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法，开源后训练能以小团队媲美前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
views.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破，需警惕过度优化，开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

views.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽，重点转向后训练和推理扩展。

views.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade; Chinese open models set industry standard; US-China gap may widen.
views.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年，中国开放模型树立行业标准，中美差距可能拉大。

people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
views.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
views.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
views.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；中美实验室在研究上无差距。

views.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed.
views.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类必须保持主权；脑机接口是必要的。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing is unsafe without safety checks.
views.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式；智能体开始工作；超级智能临近；开源需谨慎，必须通过安全测试。

people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months from now, not today.
views.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

views.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity per engineer grows 200%.
views.zh: 2026 年初，认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为构建者，人均生产力提升 200%。

views.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals insufficient for real-world behavior.
views.zh: 2026 年，主张通过早期发布研究安全，内部评估不足以反映真实世界行为。

views.en: Agents and loops are future; MCP enables enterprise adoption; non-engineers code.
views.zh: 2026 年中，强调智能体和循环是未来，MCP 促进企业采用，非工程师也能编程。

views.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction; models self-improve.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，转向主动式 AI，具备记忆和自主性，减少指令，模型自我改进。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering is a rare evolving skill.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出模型能力超出当前工具框架，工具链工程是稀缺且不断演进的技能。

views.en: RAG is anti-pattern; graph-based context search and bespoke memory outperform.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 已过时，图结构上下文检索和定制记忆更优。

views.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代对话而非静态文档，模型越聪明提示越精简。

views.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张独立验证智能体减少偏差，过度约束反而降低性能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic.
views.zh: AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

views.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as velocity rises.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

views.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches; satisfaction shifts from flow to product impact.
views.zh: 工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；结对编程午餐；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

views.en: Non-engineers ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases; apprenticeship models for next-gen engineers.
views.zh: 非工程师也能交付代码，角色模糊；上下文切换增加；下一代工程师需要学徒制。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的核心。

views.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
views.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

views.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
views.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

views.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

views.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
views.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
views.zh: 2025 年，坚信缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

views.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck; human-AI collaboration essential.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能少量监督解决开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈；人机协作至关重要。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL excels in objective domains; evals in crisis; unified architectures reduce cost.
views.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律依然成立；强化学习擅长客观领域；评估陷入危机；统一架构降低成本。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI tools accelerate science, not replace scientists.
views.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 工具加速科学发现，而非取代科学家。

views.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for scientific utility.
views.zh: 2025 年 11 月：AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏，且科学应用中无需完美可解释性。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it predicts, not understands, leaving understanding to humans.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AlphaFold 2 的提升来自众多中型胜利和专用架构，而非 Scaling；它提供预测而非理解，理解仍留给人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
views.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是在插值人类知识，而非超越它。

views.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, despite computational cost.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习以提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

views.en: Pluralistic alignment is preferable to debiasing the internet; small models can match frontier ones with diverse synthetic data.
views.zh: 2026 年，我主张用多元对齐取代对互联网的去偏；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能媲美前沿模型。

views.en: Open research and democratization of AI are essential; collaboration is needed to compete with closed labs.
views.zh: 始终，我坚信开放研究和 AI 民主化至关重要；需要合作才能与封闭实验室竞争。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human abilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应作为增强人类能力的工具，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

views.en: Africa can leapfrog legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local education; AI safety is the biggest open challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲可跨越遗留问题，语言模型可革新本地教育，而 AI 安全是最大的开放挑战。

views.en: Consistently advocates for AI as a tool for all humanity, emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and responsible deployment.
views.zh: 始终倡导 AI 作为全人类的工具，强调多样性、包容性和负责任部署。

views.en: Shifted from technical optimism about scaling and generalist agents to broader societal concerns like safety and global equity.
views.zh: 从 2023 年对 Scaling 和通用智能体的技术乐观，转向 2026 年更广泛的社会关切，如安全与全球公平。

views.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; human skills like communication are as important as coding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题，沟通等人际技能与编码同等重要。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。
